title: Acme system design 1: a rate limiter for a public API (not rendered yet)

lines.text: One client sends ten thousand requests a second. Everyone else slows down.
We need a limit per client. Let's design it.
A fixed window counts requests per minute. It lets a burst through at the edge.
A sliding window smooths that edge, at the cost of more memory.
A token bucket refills at a steady rate and allows a small, planned burst.
One shared store gives exact counts but adds a network hop to every request.
Counters on each node are fast but drift; sync them every second.
